page: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-64-lssd is an x86_64 server instance optimized for memory-dense and I/O-intensive workloads. It is powered by a dedicated AMD EPYC 9B45 processor providing 32 physical cores and 64 virtual CPUs with two threads per core. The compute hardware includes 48 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache, along with support for AVX-512 instructions such as AVX-512 VNNI and BF16. Memory capacity is substantial at 504.0 GB of RAM, equating to 7.88 GB per vCPU. Local storage is bundled, providing 2412 GB across six NVMe solid-state drives, while no dedicated hardware GPUs are present.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computational and memory performance. The instance achieves top-tier results in single-threaded stress-ng testing (3449.09) and PassMark CPU testing (91421.05), alongside strong multi-core processing (109864.8). Large-block memory bandwidth registers at 203.23 GB/s for reads and 129.23 GB/s for writes. Data throughput capabilities are further reflected in PassMark database operations, which scored in the top ten percent at 39499.25, alongside Redis SET operations reaching 110.03 million operations per second and single-threaded gzip compression at 37.63 GB/s.

The integration of substantial memory capacity, high-throughput local NVMe storage, and dedicated AMD EPYC cores makes this instance resource-efficient for heavy data operations. The architecture removes external network storage latency for temporary datasets and caching tiers. Best-fit workloads include in-memory databases such as Redis, large relational database management systems, data warehousing, high-concurrency static web serving, and intensive compression or ETL pipelines.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4d-highmem-64-lssd is a high-memory compute instance driven by a 32-core, 64-thread AMD EPYC 9B45 processor on x86_64 architecture. Equipped with 504.0 GB of system memory, it offers an elevated memory-to-vCPU ratio of 7.88 GB per core, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions. The instance incorporates 2412 GB of high-speed local NVMe SSD storage across six drives, while omitting dedicated GPUs. Benchmark evaluations show top-decile performance in PassMark CPU evaluations, single-core stress-ng tests, and database transaction benchmarks, supported by 203.23 GB/s of large-block uncached memory read bandwidth. With strong data manipulation capabilities, including over 110 million Redis SET operations per second and 71.98 GB/s in static web throughput, the instance delivers high data density. It is specifically suited for memory-bound applications, low-latency relational and NoSQL databases, large-scale ETL processing, and high-throughput caching tiers.
